cycles.rationale: First submission: LightGBM multiclass classifier with engineered photometric colour-index features (u-g, g-r, r-i, i-z, and combinations), redshift transforms (log1p, squared), magnitude statistics, encoded spectral_type and galaxy_population categoricals, and redshift×colour interactions. Class imbalance handled via sample_weight inversely proportional to class frequencies. Uses n_jobs=-1 for all 16 CPU cores, 1000 trees with 127 leaves, learning_rate=0.05. Trains on full 490K-row dataset. Optimizes for balanced accuracy across 3-class GALAXY/QSO/STAR prediction.

cycles.rationale: Prior submission (art-9968a830722d, score 0.9664) was rejected with exit 137 (OOM kill). Root cause: LightGBM 1500 trees × 255 leaves + XGBoost 1000 trees × depth-7 on 490K rows exceeded the 2GB RAM budget. Fix: removed XGBoost entirely (biggest RAM consumer), reduced LightGBM num_leaves 255→127 and n_estimators 1500→1000. All feature engineering, class-weight balancing, and threshold calibration are preserved. LightGBM with 127 leaves on this dataset fits comfortably under 2GB.

cycles.rationale:
Three focused improvements to close the 0.0053 gap vs target 0.9714:
1. Added CatBoostClassifier (2000 iterations, depth=8, thread_count=-1) as a complementary model — CatBoost uses symmetric trees with ordered boosting, producing orthogonal predictions to LightGBM GBDT. Blended 70% LGB + 30% CatBoost.
2. Stronger LightGBM: num_leaves 255→511, n_estimators 2000→3000, lr 0.03→0.02 (more trees, lower lr = better generalization).
3. OOF target encoding for spectral_type and galaxy_population — 5-fold out-of-fold mean-encoding creates 6 smooth probability features per class, capturing categorical signal without leakage. Total features: 80→86.
Replaced ExtraTreesClassifier (lower capacity) with CatBoost (higher capacity). All seeds fixed, n_jobs=-1 / thread_count=-1 for full CPU utilization.

cycles.rationale: Prior submission exited with code 137 (OOM). Root cause: ExtraTreesClassifier with 500 trees on 490K rows × ~60 features consumes too much memory (node-split storage vs LightGBM histograms). Fix: removed ExtraTrees entirely; replaced with a second LightGBM (different learning rate/num_leaves/regularization for ensemble diversity). Two LightGBMs share histogram memory efficiently. Added explicit gc.collect() between models to free memory. All feature engineering and prior-scaling calibration preserved.
